fusions.name: Leaves of Limestone
fusions.desc: Looses 5 limestone leaves at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Hitting an enemy gives your party 15% more damage for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Folio Cut
fusions.desc: A paper-thin edge of reef that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Countersigned
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Well-Indexed
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 6%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter.
